audit.why: Content chart (Sion, Skill, Skill, Skill, Neeko, Neeko, Sion) matches the packet exactly and reads correctly against a 49.16% win rate over 1489 games: she owns the level 6 to first-item window, you own level 1 and the two-item stage. No full-layer entry exists for this matchup, so there is no paired chart to reconcile.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike never gave Pop Blossom's cooldown, so 'never all-in when her ult is available' had no timer attached.
audit.why: Pop Blossom is 120/105/90 and Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 — those two numbers define the entire level-6-to-first-item survival window.
audit.corrected: mid now carries the 120-second ult and the 10-12s root cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors, both repeated across whys, spikes, mid and wants: (a) the Pop Blossom disguise was credited to her W clone; (b) her Q was called short-range and her root described as something she must walk onto the wave to land.
audit.why: Shapesplitter (W) sends a controllable clone — the disguise that hides the Pop Blossom wind-up is Inherent Glamour (P), which lets her appear as an ally or another unit. And her ranges beat yours: Blooming Burst 800, Tangle-Barbs 1000, against Roar of the Slayer's 800. She does not have to walk up at all.
audit.corrected: Disguise attributed to Inherent Glamour everywhere it drove advice; real ranges written into whys[0] and early.

edits.before: Her Q poke is short-range and she must walk up to land Tangle-Barbs — your zombie passive means she cannot freely bully you off the wave, and a partial Q charge punishes any overstep.
edits.after: Blooming Burst reaches 800 and Tangle-Barbs 1000, so she out-ranges you — but Glory in Death means her kill attempt is never free, and a partial Q charge punishes any overstep.

edits.before: Pop Blossom is a channeled AOE stun she can hide in a W clone disguise — if it lands into a rooted Sion it is a near-certain kill and Unstoppable Onslaught is your only clean escape.
edits.after: Pop Blossom's wind-up is hidden while Inherent Glamour has her disguised — landed on a rooted Sion it is a near-certain kill, and Unstoppable Onslaught is your only clean exit.

edits.before: Pop Blossom is a channeled AOE stun Neeko can hide inside her W clone disguise — if it lands into a rooted Sion it is a near-certain kill; Unstoppable Onslaught away from the ring.
edits.after: Inherent Glamour hides Pop Blossom's wind-up entirely — a disguised Neeko landing it on a rooted Sion is a near-certain kill; charge Unstoppable Onslaught out of the ring.

edits.before: Neeko's Q (Blooming Burst) has short range and she must walk onto the wave to land Tangle-Barbs (E) — she is not a true long-range bully. Take Doran's Shield and absorb Q ticks while looking for a partial Q charge when she steps forward. Hold charges behind minion bodies on the side she approaches from; do not chase her into open ground where she roots you mid-channel. At level 1 your zombie passive means she cannot freely burst you off the lane — even your death costs her.
edits.after: Blooming Burst reaches 800 and Tangle-Barbs 1000, so she roots you from outside your own E range — a poke lane, not a walk-up one. Take Doran's Shield and absorb Q ticks while looking for a partial Q charge when she steps forward. Hold charges behind minion bodies on the side she approaches from; do not chase her into open ground where she roots you mid-channel. At level 1 your zombie passive means she cannot freely burst you off the lane — even your death costs her.

edits.before: At 6 the dynamic shifts — watch for a W clone disguise sitting still on the wave, because that is Pop Blossom channelling. Unstoppable Onslaught charges away from the AOE ring or step out before it fires. Between level 6 and first item farm safely and punish only on missed Tangle-Barbs; never all-in when her root or ult is available. This is the one window she can actually kill you, so play conservatively and wait for your Heartsteel timing.
edits.after: At 6 the dynamic shifts — a disguised Neeko standing still near the wave is Pop Blossom winding up, and Inherent Glamour hides that wind-up completely. Charge Unstoppable Onslaught out of the ring or walk clear before it lands. Between level 6 and first item farm safely and punish only on a missed Tangle-Barbs (10-12s); never all-in while her root or her 120-second ult is up. This is the one window she can kill you, so wait for your Heartsteel timing.

edits.before: Disguise as a minion with W clone and channel Pop Blossom (R) undetected for a rooted stun-burst kill
edits.after: Use Inherent Glamour's disguise to hide the Pop Blossom wind-up and stun you out of a landed root
